facts.fact: 导师 Sinead 去年 exam 后邀他加入 Honours/Masters 团队，本章当面重申 offer 仍有效。
facts.anchor: The offer is still there though, and I want you to seriously consider it.

facts.fact: Sinead 的临别赠言：人生关口别急着说不，能抓住的机会都说好——「I have big hopes for you」。
facts.anchor: Don’t say no to anything yet. Say yes to every opportunity you can.

facts.fact: 冻僵的脚球局里 Ben 开出停赛条件：说清你和 Eden 到底什么情况。
facts.anchor: When you tell me what’s going on with you and Eden.

facts.fact: Oliver 的顾虑：家教平台 code of conduct——开始一段关系可能让他丢工作。
facts.anchor: I’m not sure if it breaches my code of conduct if we start something.

facts.fact: Ben 用 taco 广告梗抛出两全方案：porque no los dos——打零工与读研为什么不能都要。
facts.anchor: Why fight over hard or soft tacos when you can have both?

facts.fact: 写书工程：数百封邮件寄给妈妈的旧同事，换回数百封回信——「她被多少人爱着令人无所适从」。
facts.anchor: I’ve sent hundreds of emails to her former colleagues

facts.fact: 爸爸书房翻出妈妈怀孕与幼年照片，滑雪照上一滴失控的泪——他正在忘记她的声音和气味。
facts.anchor: I’m forgetting what she sounded like, what she smelt like.

facts.fact: 备课清单：Year 9 文本分析、Year 11 语言与论证——以及给 Eden 的 authorial intent，花时最长。
facts.anchor: Text analysis essays for a Year 9, language and arguments for a Year 11. Authorial intent for Eden.

facts.fact: 餐桌招安答复：open to it，但若去读研只承诺干到今年年底。
facts.anchor: all I can commit to is for the rest of the year.

facts.fact: 父亲拍背——多年来第一次肢体接触，让他觉得自己「总算做对了一件事」。
facts.anchor: It’s the first physical contact we’ve had in years
